brief: Select array entries that pass a test
description: Return a new array of the entries of array for which predicate returns true. Every index is considered, including entries whose value is undefined. Order of kept entries is preserved.

parameters.description: The array to walk. A string is not walked as an array: write [...value] to walk its characters.
parameters.name: array

parameters.dataTypeParameter: (value: any, index?: integer, array?: array) => boolean
parameters.description: Returns true to keep the entry. A script function is called with (value, index, array); a built-in function is called with the value alone, since its other parameters have their own meanings.
parameters.name: predicate

returns.description: A new array of the entries that passed the test (possibly empty).
